title: LogEntry canonical bytes format duplicated across append.rs, verify.rs, and verify test helper
description: What is awkward: the canonical byte representation for LogEntry signing (hlc_timestamp BE8 || article_cid || sorted parent_cids) appears three times independently: (1) compute_entry_id in append.rs (includes operator_signature for the ID hash), (2) verify_entry in verify.rs (excludes operator_signature for the verified-over content), (3) canonical_bytes test helper inside verify.rs tests. These are the same conceptual format with a one-field difference. A future contributor editing one may miss the others. Suggested rewrite: define compute_entry_canonical_bytes(entry, include_sig: bool) -> Vec<u8> in a single place (canonical.rs or a dedicated append_canonical.rs) and have both compute_entry_id and verify_entry call it.
